notes.title: The Regreening joins the Wholesome Games Celebration! 🌸✨
notes.content:
Hello, friends!! 
Wholesome Games Celebration is a lovely event that runs August 7–14 and brings together handpicked cozy, kind-hearted games from around the world. We’re overjoyed for The Regreening to be nestled among them like a tiny mushroom under a leafy tree. 🍄


So, what’s The Regreening again?
If you're just joining us, The Regreening is a cozy game about caring for plants, restoring animal habitats, befriending quirky folklore spirits, and seeing how the desert transforms into a green oasis thanks to you!

We’re making our game for anyone who wants to unwind after a long day, maybe curled up in bed with a warm drink, a handheld console, and (yes-yes!) no rush. So, cozy vibes, animal friends, and a lot of plants doing their best. But don’t worry, you’ll help them out :)


Help us grow: Wishlists & More 🌿
We’re a small team, and every single reaction and wishlist means the world to us! We’ve recently started our social media accounts, and it's been amazing so far! (we really enjoy it haha)


[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45667437/7f531a5ea0cf760623e928898ebc048a75a89249.png"]

Here’s what you can do to support us:

💚 Please wishlist The Regreening! It helps us tremendously by making it easier for new folks to discover our game.

💌 Sign up for our newsletter! We’ll send you development updates, ask for your thoughts on things we’re working on, and maybe share the occasional frog fact :)
🎁 Pssst: You’ll also get a little gift in our next email!

👋 Follow us around the internet! We’re on 📷 Instagram | 🎵 TikTok | 🐦 X/Twitter | 🦋 Bluesky so come say hi! We love meeting new friends <3

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45667437/49b1260ce7609ce6d13e67f2cc00e2728d897ccf.png"]

That’s all for now, friends! Now go explore the celebration!!
There’s so much cozy magic waiting to be found ٩(^ᗜ^ )و ´-



With mossy gratitude,
 — Volha & The Regreening Team 🌼

notes.title: The Regreening is Forged in Germany! With a cozy, soft, wholesome hammer.
notes.content:
Hallo, dear friends! 🌱💚
Today’s a special day for The Regreening. Why? Because we're part of our very first Steam event:

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45667437/7713979e6fd9cc01ce5a0fd6f56e31038eed4fa7.png"]

We’re proud and very grateful to join our fellow amazing German studios and initiatives who are crafting beautiful, weird, innovative, and heartfelt games.

To celebrate, we’re super excited to finally reveal what we’ve been growing in our backyards:

🌍 The Regreening Steam Page is now available in whole 11 languages! (Hi, ola, привіт, ahoj, 你好merhaba, and beyond!) We want players from all corners of the world to feel at home in The Regreening.

So consider checking it out and wishlisting! Because, you know, wishlisting is free and it helps every game and developer be seen 🌿

[dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3419080/The_Regreening/"][/dynamiclink][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45667437/67925e760e9427b301ada6c87324e79b509ba3ef.png"]

And if you want behind-the-scenes peeks and cozy updates, sign up for our newsletter. There’s room for everyone around our virtual campfire.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45667437/49b1260ce7609ce6d13e67f2cc00e2728d897ccf.png"]

Thank you for being here, and let’s regreen the world!

— Volha & The Regreening Team 💚
